newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzania shilling weakens on dollar, pound.
newsitem.headline: Tanzania shilling weakens on dollar, pound.

text.p: The Tanzania shilling weakened against the dollar and pound on Friday as forex supply decreased, dealers said.
Against the dollar the shilling traded at a mean commercial rate of 618.6807 from 617.7600 on Thursday. Against the pound the shilling traded at mean rate 1013.8971 from 1011.3056 on Thursday.
Last Friday the shilling stood at 613.3050 against the dollar and 996.6237 against the pound.
Dealers blamed the main commercial National Bank of Commerce for offering few dollars on the interbank forex market and said importers were speculating on possible tax cuts in the June 19 budget.
